info.name: Stripe MPP API 💳💳💳
info.description:
- No existing BuiltWith account or API key is required. Connect to `https://api.builtwith.com/mcp` without authentication and start with `mpp-catalog`.
- MCP flow: `mpp-catalog` -> `mpp-purchase` -> authorize the returned challenge with a Stripe MPP wallet -> retry the identical purchase -> `mpp-data` with the returned `access_token`.
- HTTP catalog: `GET https://payments.builtwith.com/v1/mpp/catalog`. Purchase: `POST https://payments.builtwith.com/v1/mpp/purchase`.
- Smallest guest purchase: `{"product":"api-credits","credits":10,"token_hours":24}` costs US$0.50 for 10 lookups. Up to 1,999 credits use the normal entry rate ($0.0495 each), rounded to cents with Stripe's $0.50 minimum; quantities of 2,000 or more use existing tiered pricing.
- Guest tokens default to 24 hours from fulfilment. Set integer `token_hours` from 1 to 720 in the initial purchase to request another duration. Retrying does not extend expiry. Keep the token and purchase recovery key secret; expired guest access cannot spend remaining credits.
- Guest requests require a newly generated random UUID in `Idempotency-Key`. Repeat the same body and key for every retry/status check, and add the MPP `Authorization: Payment ...` credential to pay. Do not start another purchase to recover an uncertain charge.
- Success returns `access_token`, `token_expires` and `Payment-Receipt`. Use the token with `mpp-data`, `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN` on MCP, or `Authorization: API TOKEN` on REST.
- Products remain `basic` ($295), `pro` ($495), `team` ($995), and `api-credits`. Lists/prospect searches require a plan; a small lookup-credit purchase does not grant Lists access. Plans are non-recurring and last one calendar month; guest token expiry is separate.
- Existing accounts may continue sending `X-BuiltWith-API-Key`. Their existing purchase rules, including the 2,000-credit minimum, are unchanged; omit `token_hours` for existing-account purchases.
- Stripe MPP accepts card SPTs only. x402 Base USDC and saved-card billing are separate integrations.

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.

request.description: Payment operation. Generate one UUID into mppIdempotencyKey before the first request; reuse the identical body and key for every retry. Authorize the returned challenge with a Stripe MPP wallet, then enable the Payment authorization header.

variable.description: Set your BuiltWith API key locally; do not share its value.
